description: A pet dino for your board. Press the button and Diny drops in, then hops between the tops of the shapes in your view and along the bottom of the screen, turning to face the way it goes. Click Diny and it shouts. Only you see it: nothing on the board changes, nothing syncs to collaborators, and the board stays usable all around it. Diny comes back whenever you open a board until you press the button again to send it away.
